discussion.key_messages: - Accumulating mountain snow is expected across all Utah mountains through  Monday morning. Upwards of 12" of snow is expected above 9000   feet, and 3-6" of snow down to around 7000 feet. Upper elevations of the Cottonwoods and western Uintas may see   localized accumulations 18-24". - Cool, dry, and stable conditions build in Tuesday following the passage of this system. - A weak system looks to impact the region Wednesday/Thursday ushering in a brief period of low elevation rainfall and high elevation snowfall across primarily northern and central Utah.
